content: For image-output regression across renderer versions/hardware, common tooling: PerceptualDiff (perceptual-model diff with a pixel-count-based pass/fail threshold), ImageMagick 'compare' (multiple selectable metrics: AE, RMSE, PSNR, MAE, MSE, NCC, PHASH, DSSIM), and pyssim for SSIM. PSNR/RMSE are known to be weak at catching perceptually-relevant differences; DSSIM/perceptual metrics are preferred for renderer regression testing with a tunable tolerance.
